title: Uniform derived cohomological-dimension bounds for unbounded quasi-coherent complexes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Finite cohomological dimension on individual sheaves must be promoted to truncation control for unbounded complexes. The proof computes the derived inverse limit of lower truncations, proves eventual stabilization in each degree and kills the lim1 term, thereby obtaining explicit degree bounds.
